note: Family-owned since the early 1970s on nearly 50 wooded acres along the Kalamazoo River near Hanover, with a canoe/kayak livery. Directory listings (not the operator) describe electric+water and primitive sites, a May - mid-October season and nightly rates around $35-40. --Claude
summary: The .org domain no longer resolves; the operator's current domain twinpinescampgrounds.com (Google and Facebook both name it) forwards to a bare 2019 WordPress page whose Contact page gives the phone 517-524-6298 (matches), office hours and 'call or stop out to make reservations'. Facebook (500 reviews, 92% recommend) confirms hot showers and a camp store. Google Maps: 'Twin Pine Campground & Canoe', 9800 Wheeler Rd, Hanover, open, 4.5 / 338 reviews, phone matches. No operator rate, hookups or season anywhere; water hookup and season left as derived. Price indicator: RV Life $$. Note: dropped the stale .org remark and the facts now in fields.
